subject: Pilot extension request while PO completes
messages:
From: Natalie O'Neill <natalie@orthopulse.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: OrthoPulse Procurement <procurement@orthopulse.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: pilot extension while PO completes

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for walking us through the sandbox yesterday — the team is excited and we started integration tests this morning. Unfortunately our procurement queue flagged an additional security attestation and that pushed the PO approval out of this week. The PO is in the vendor queue (I have a reference number below) but finance says it won't be fully routed until next Wednesday.

Can Redwood grant a short extension on our pilot so the timers don't expire while the PO moves through approvals? Ideally 2–3 weeks so we can finish the final end-to-end validation and share results with our board. We can provide the PO reference now: PR-OP-0427.

We understand there are terms for extensions — happy to sign a one-off addendum. If helpful, procurement is copied (procurement@orthopulse.com).

Appreciate any flexibility,

— Natalie
Natalie O'Neill
Head of Product, OrthoPulse Health
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Natalie O'Neill <natalie@orthopulse.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pilot extension while PO completes

Hi Natalie — thanks for the heads up and congrats to the team on getting integration started.

Short answer: yes, we can help keep the pilot active while PR-OP-0427 completes routing. Before I lock in specifics, two quick asks so we set expectations correctly:

- Can procurement confirm the expected approval date (you mentioned next Wednesday — what calendar date is that for your team)?
- Do you need any additional security artifacts from us (SOC2 evidence, runbook excerpts) to speed finance?

Proposed interim support: we can provision a 14-day extension and seed the account with a 1,000-demo-credit allotment to cover tooling and tests. That will get you through the final validations. We'll follow up with a short addendum (single page) to cover the extension terms. I attached the draft terms for your legal team to glance at.

If you need a longer window (21 days) let me know and I can escalate for approval.

I copied Kimberly (Commercial Ops) to hold the paperwork and Camila (Solutions) to ensure the environment stays stable while you validate.

Best,

Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

Attachment: trial_extension_terms.pdf

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the quick reply.

Procurement confirmed the PO should be approved by 2027-04-21 (they put it in expedited review after I pushed). We do need the SOC2 snippets you mentioned; procurement asked for the control matrix (I attached a short note). If you can share the SOC2 cover sheet and the control mapping, I can push it through.

Regarding the extension, would Redwood be willing to approve 21 days instead of 14? Our board review is late in that window and having a slightly longer runway would be safer for our validation timeline. If it helps, we can mark the PO as binding once it reaches the final approver (procurement@orthopulse.com will confirm the final status).

Quote from your earlier message:
> Proposed interim support: we can provision a 14-day extension and seed the account with a 1,000-demo-credit allotment to cover tooling and tests.

If you can stretch to 21 days and 1,500 credits, that would cover the tests and a follow-up performance run.

Best,

— Natalie
Natalie O'Neill
Head of Product, OrthoPulse Health
